requested: review the completed unified-Oracle and alternating Planner-IDM replacement
forbidden: training, simulator, server, Git publication, or policy-quality claims

review.scope: fresh self-review of the complete local diff and offline evidence

source_edits.scope: local reversible v011 source, config, tests, contracts, and receipts

report_write.scope: local plans, contracts, evidence, and review receipts

repository_discipline.rationale: The implementation keeps checkpoint inspection cold-path, behavior rules in owners, Hydra at composition, and evidence claims offline-only.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: The new 53-line fada_oracle gateway owns format selection; trainer owns update order; checkpoint owns persistence; collectors only consume one policy.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: All main scenarios receive one frozen tensor policy and no checkpoint-format detail leaks into collectors.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: SAC and distillation loaders terminate at the cold-path gateway; intermediate SAC loading remains explicitly IDM-only.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: One resident final Oracle is immutable, update order is serialized, and schema-5 save is atomic with both optimizer states.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The replacement deletes the phase owner and two-stage test suite instead of retaining parallel active modes.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: 498 FADA tests, 107 adjacent tests, Ruff, Pyright, and diff checks support offline implementation only.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Five expected RED failures preceded direct loader, gradient-order, schema, workflow, and official-consumer GREEN evidence.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: The Oracle gateway validates 98-to-29 before collection; source rows retain 66/29/3 and schema 4.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Tests prove IDM changes first, Planner changes second, and IDM tensors do not change during Planner backward and step.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema 5 requires schedule and paired optimizers; schemas 1-4 remain inference-readable and training resume stays disabled.

dimensions.name: maintainability-delta
dimensions.evidence: Production and test diff removes 1200 lines and adds 289 tracked lines plus one narrow 53-line gateway; large owners did not grow materially.

dimensions.name: modification-cost
dimensions.evidence: C3 migration cost is closed by direct owner tests, schema matrix, official consumer tests, and removal of the superseded path.

dimensions.name: automatic-recommendation
dimensions.evidence: Accept the local engineering diff and stop before the separate formal-runtime and training gates.

residual_risks.description: The approved server checkpoint identity and native runtime have not been exercised in this local unit.
residual_risks.disposition: Run a fresh formal-runtime audit before separately authorized training.

residual_risks.description: Offline module tests cannot establish convergence, stable locomotion, or superiority over v010.
residual_risks.disposition: Use post-training policy-quality audit after an authorized campaign.

implementation.evidence: Oracle authority, optimizer lifecycle, checkpoint schema, workflow, and config changed together.

verification.evidence: Gradient, persistence, source admission, async lifecycle, and official consumers required separate proof.

compatibility.evidence: Historical schemas remain playback-only while schema 5 is new-training only.

recovery.evidence: The diff is uncommitted and no external state changed.

uncertainty.evidence: Server identity, runtime reachability, convergence, and policy quality remain outside this unit.

responsibility.evidence: One final-policy owner replaces scenario-switched authorities.

change_amplification.evidence: New Oracle formats terminate at one 53-line gateway.

dependency.evidence: Collectors no longer know SAC or distillation checkpoint types.

caller_knowledge.evidence: Callers consume one frozen tensor policy and one schedule.

state_lifecycle.evidence: One campaign replaces phase transfer and pretrained-IDM identity.

testability.evidence: Loader, update order, and persistence have direct isolated tests.

compatibility.evidence: There is no dual active training schema or compatibility branch.

temporal_coupling.evidence: Trainer and schema intentionally share one schedule identity.

uncertainty.evidence: Planner label authority is now one explicit checkpoint role.

required_actions: keep v011 as the only active base FADA training contract
require formal runtime audit before training
do not restore scenario-specific policy selection
maintainability_delta.rationale: The invasive migration is acceptable because it retires the old lifecycle in the same unit, reduces total code, and leaves live uncertainty explicit.
